newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end mixed, trade slow ahead of FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end mixed, trade slow ahead of FOMC.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended mixed on Tuesday, with most participants sidelined on the last trading day for September delivery and ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve's policy-setting meeting scheduled for later today. Brokers said the sluggish trade may continue for a while.
The key Nikkei 225 average closed up 59.75 points or 0.28 percent at 21,171.99. But its December futures were down 20 points to close at 21,160.
The TOPIX index of all first section stocks dipped 2.91 points or 0.18 percent to end at 1,589.48.
